faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: DebateLab offers a 3-day free trial with 5 AI requests per day. After that, Pro is $5/month + tax for unlimited requests and premium models.
faq.q2: What do I get with Pro?
faq.a2: Unlimited AI requests, access to premium models (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini Pro), Active Grounding™ research, and priority support.
faq.a3: Yes, you can cancel anytime from your Settings page. You'll retain access until the end of your billing period.
faq.q4: Does the AI make things up?
faq.a4: We use Active Grounding™ technology to verify claims against real sources. Any unverified information is clearly marked as such.
faq.q5: Can I save and export my work?
faq.a5: Yes! Save cases, brainstorms, and chats to History. Export to Word, PDF, or Google Docs.
